title: Cross-Cutting Hooks at Plugin Level
summary: Implements five cross-cutting concerns as hooks in hooks/hooks.json at the plugin level, since plugin-provided agents cannot define hooks in their own frontmatter: an invariant reminder (PreToolUse on Write/Edit under docs/), an epistemic gate enforcer (Stop), a skill activator (UserPromptSubmit), an orientation trigger (PostToolUse on key artifacts), and a document sizing check (PostToolUse on docs/). The epistemic gate enforcer uses reminder injection rather than blocking, since a blocking Stop hook would prevent the agent from completing at all rather than resuming the phase.
workflow_point: cross-cutting, plugin-level (fires across all phase skills)
mechanism: five PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/Stop hooks replacing duplicated per-skill logic

links.note: the skill-activator hook fires on the UserPromptSubmit event this ADR establishes; ADR-035 specifies its matching pattern and injected content.
